name: persistent-login
title: Keep login alive: drop refresh token rotation, 365d TTL, tolerant refresh, ext auto-sync
description: Single-user deployment: after one login on the website, both web tabs and the Chromium extension stay logged in (up to 1 year sliding), by removing refresh-token rotation, extending refresh TTL to 365 days, making refresh failure handling tolerant of transient errors, and adding an extension content script that syncs login state from the site.
creator: guangzi-bianxie
